shared_elements: low-relief human hand shown in profile with articulated fingers and thumb
densely patterned textile or garment surface with fringed edges
banded horizontal registers of small repeated units
fragment of figure's arm/wrist with bracelet-like band
justification: Both surfaces show the same distinctive combination of a carefully rendered profile hand emerging beside rosette roundels, set against heavily patterned, fringed garment fabric rendered in flat low relief with fine repeated incised units — a conventional cluster unlikely to arise independently. The main difference in content is that A presents a complete standing winged figure with bucket and raised hand as the dominant subject, whereas B is dominated by dense horizontal bands of repeated sign-like marks running across the figural elements, which are reduced to fragments.
